evidence.quote: There is good reason to think that the normalization of monetary policies in advanced economies should continue to prove manageable for EMEs.
suggesting that markets should not be surprised by our actions if the economy evolves in line with expectations.
overall U.S. domestic financial conditions have gotten looser, in part due to improving global conditions and central bank policy abroad.
All that said, I do not dismiss the prospective risks emanating from global policy normalization.

It offers a mild hawkish lean on continuing normalization but little direct guidance on inflation or activity, so it scores as roughly neutral.
